front.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / hidden sprite underpainting.
Edit target: the provided existing front-view game character PNG. This is NOT a new character design.
Remove ONLY the screen-left arm (the arm on the LEFT side of the image), including its sleeve/gauntlet/glove, and remove the entire sword. Leave a clean shoulder attachment point, no hanging arm, no sword and no floating fragments.
Complete the tiny areas of the original black-and-white armored coat, grey trousers and dark boots that were previously obscured by that arm and sword. Both legs and feet must remain in exactly the original standing pose and locations. Keep the other arm.
INVARIANTS: preserve the same face, hair, head/body ratio, cobalt blue cape, clothing details, palette, outlines and soft painted shading. Same exact front/back/side orientation as the input, same camera, same canvas composition and blank margins. Do NOT enlarge, recenter, zoom, turn, stretch or redesign the character. The figure remains small in the lower middle, exactly where it is now. Keep the original 320x320 coordinate layout proportionally if output is larger.
Output a full-body underpainting sprite with a genuinely transparent background. No labels, grids, shadows, text, particles, glow, weapons or new props. The remaining character must be one coherent clean connected torso and both legs; only the specified arm is absent. This underpainting will be used only for concealed pixels in the existing sprite.
front.use: Only arm/sword-occluded pixels; remaining original sprite pixels retained.
